chapters: Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat bɨɨx jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx gu chio'ñ ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiix bɨx jɨ'xdha' jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel tu' gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ bopxi'ñ maa'n mo'o gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ no'm bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Elisur gu mar gu Sedeur.
Jano' ba' gu Simeoon gu Selumiel gu mar gu Surisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu Judaa gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' gu Issakâr gu Natanael gu mar gu Suar.
Jano' ba' gu Sabuloon gu Eliab gu mar gu eloon.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu Epraim gu Elisama gu mar gu Ammiud; mi' dhɨr gu Manasees gu Gamaliel gu mar gu Pedasur.
Jano' ba' gu Benjamiin gu Abidaan gu mar gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' gu Dan gu Aieser gu mar gu Ammisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu Aser gu Pegiel gu mar gu Okraan.
Jano' ba' gu Gad gu Eliasap gu mar gu Deuel.
Jano' ba' gu Neptalii gu Aira gu mar gu Enaan.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook chiñia' bopxi'ñ tattat gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees gu Aaroon dhi' ja'tkam gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix bɨɨx duu gu vaak tattat bhaan jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix ɨɨbhidham.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' ɨɨbhidham bɨx gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen jix bɨɨx duu oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' ɨɨbhidham bɨx gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vaik.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Gad oo'm jixchamaam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Judaa maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr mambhɨɨx maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon mambhɨɨx kɨɨv jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Epraim oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu ñi'ook jixchamaam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Aser oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii mambhɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx chiñia' gu Israeel jix duñia' maa'n gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vaak tattat gu ñi'ook jiix bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas cham jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ bhaan bopxi'ñ tattat.
Ba' jix aa' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bopxi'ñ gu Lebii tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bhaan bɨx bhaan bɨx tu'x; gio ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx vaak zel xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas; na pai' dhuuk vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Lebitas gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh na jix bhai' koi.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel maa'n ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu Lebitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut cham daak bhaan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Lebitas jix duñia' jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duu.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' maa'n ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tattat; gio ba' xikoolh vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix duñia' tas buusñi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu Naasoon gu mar gu Aminadab.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu Natanael gu mar gu Suar.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mambhɨɨx maakobh jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon gu Eliab gu mar gu eloon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mambhɨɨx kɨɨv jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Judaa chamaam jix bhai'x vupui bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Rubeen saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Elisur gu mar gu Sedeur.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' ju'ñdharan bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu Selumiel gu mar gu Surisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x vaik.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu Eliasap gu mar gu Reuel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx oo'm jixchamaam jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Rubeen chamaam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx gook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut yooxi' gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ chugi'ñ; gio ba' yooxi' maa'n pai' ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Epraim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tas gei'ñ; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu Elisama gu mar gu Ammiud.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Manasees; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu Gamaliel gu mar gu Pedasur.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Benjamiin gu Abidaan gu mar gu Gedeoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jixchamaam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Epraim chamaam jix bhai'x chamaam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu Aieser gu mar gu Amisaddai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ju'ñdharan jix duñia' bopxi'ñ gu Aser; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu Pegiel gu mar gu Okraan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx oo'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii; gio ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ma'nkam gu Neptalii gu Aira gu mar gu Enaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx mambhɨɨx vaik jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Dan chamaam mambhɨɨx kɨɨv jix bhai'x; gio ba' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vaak tattat; gio ba' bɨx chugi'ñ vaik jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas cham jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu ñi'ook maa'n ja'tkam vaak bhaan gu vaak tattat.
Ba' jix aa' dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon gu Moisees dɨr gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu kavɨk gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu Nadab maa'nkam mar gu Abiuu gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Aaroon jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu noobh na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu Nadab gu Abiuu jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu tanoolh na jix bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii; gio ba' cham chooto'n gu ma'nkam; mi' dhɨr gu Eleasar tu' gu Itamar jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan vupui bhaan gu Aaroon gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ gu Lebii tu jiim gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aaroon na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na ba' tu juan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Lebitas gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam na ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' ka't gu Lebitas.

Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx maa'nkam mar; gio ba' dɨr gu tanoolh tu' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu oidha' gu Ejipto tu' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu Israeel gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax; mi' dhɨr ka't; jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii bham.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tattat ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ jiix.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii jix bɨɨx duu dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ'; gio ba' gu Gersoon gu Koat gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak dhi' ja'tkam; gio ba' gu Libni gu Simei.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Koat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Amram tu' gu Isar gu ebroon gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Maali gu Musi; mi' dhɨr dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Lebii gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu Libni gu Simei; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Gersoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' jix duñia' bɨx gu chio'ñ jiix kɨɨv jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu Gersoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu taat gu Gersonitas gu Eliasap gu mar gu Lael.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan vaak zel iiñat gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob ju'ñdharan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan ju'ñdharan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh; gio ba' na ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu Koat ja'tkam vaak gu Amramiitika ja'tkam vaak gu Iseariitika ja'tkam vaak gu ebroniitika ja'tkam vaak gu Osieliitika; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Koatitas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨx gu chio'ñ jiix jix duñia' jix bhai'x ko'kmarak jix nukadham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Koat jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan saagi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Koat gu Elisapaan gu mar gu Ussiel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu vaak na jix bhai' mɨichdhai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xidhuu bɨɨx jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx.
Jano' ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Lebitas ka't gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam namki' jix nukadham xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu Maaliitika ja'tkam vaak gu Musiitika; gio ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Merari.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' jix duñia' bɨx gu chio'ñ jiix jix bɨɨx duu jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu vaak gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Merari gu Suriel gu mar gu Abiail; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Merari vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook bɨx bɨɨx bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi'.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan tas buusñi vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut jix duñia' ka't gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ua'tulhdhidha' jix nukadham xidhuu pai' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu Moisees gu Aaroon jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ja'tkam vaak bɨx gu chio'ñ jiix jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gook ja'tkam vaak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiix gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Lebitas na ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu vaakax gu Lebitas pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu vaakax gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ jurtu'nka' jix duñia' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiix jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x vaik.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Lebitas pai' bɨx maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu vaakax gu Lebitas pai' gu vaakax; gio ba' gu Lebitas ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik daam gu Lebitas maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jixchamaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o; gio ba' jurtu'nka' xidhuu gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; mi' dhɨr juraa'n gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkam mar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tuumiñ jix bhai'x vaik gu ñi'ook jixchamaam jurtu'nka' xidhuu.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix maa tuumiñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Koat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Lebii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Koat vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut pai'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' aajim gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam jix duñia' vaak zel gu ñi'ook bɨɨx kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' chuut.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan iiñat tɨɨt gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' tu jiim gu tanoolh na jix bhai' bɨx jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' tɨkiix jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bhaan kutun kavɨk jaja' na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'; gio ba' gu takarui' gu vaak na jix bhai' kutun bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx iiñat tɨɨt; gio ba' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook mɨichdhai; gio ba' bɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bɨɨx bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam iiñat tɨɨt bhaan.
Jano' ba' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix uam jodai jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx iiñat tɨɨt jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam xidhuu jix duñia' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx iiñat tɨɨt bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' bhaan gu tanoolh na jix bhai' ñakaabma'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' bhaan iiñat tɨɨt jix duñia'.

Na pai' dhuuk a'gidhimɨk gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook xidhuu bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xidhuu na pai' dhuuk yooxi' bhɨɨya' aajim mi' dhɨr gu ma'nkam gu Koat na ba'; gu' cham gu ñi'ook abhaar koi; mi' dhɨr dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Koat vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨ'ñdhatu' gu ñi'ook gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨ'ñdhatu'; gio ba' bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan bɨx xidhuu.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu Koat tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Lebitas.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx na ba' cham na pai' dhuuk pai'; gio ba' gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam aajim jix duñia' maa'n.
Na pai' dhuuk cham jɨjɨkgɨm na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; na koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gio jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tattat ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu Gersoon na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut iiñat tɨɨt bhaan tu jiim gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' ki'ñgob mia'n vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan mia'n jodai maa'nkar Jawatan xikoolh bɨx ka't gu ñi'ook na ba'; gio ba' tu juan.
Jano' ba' bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu ma'nkam ka't bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx; gio ba' jix nukadham bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu novɨ gu Itamar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xikoolh gu ñi'ook dhi' bɨɨx bɨx; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' bɨx jix nukadham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari na ba' bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu novɨ gu Itamar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Koat ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx; gio ba' bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gook ja'tkam vaak mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu Koat bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Moisees gu Aaroon na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat jix bɨɨx duu gook ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Gersoon bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx bɨx ba'k chu'p na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak jix bɨɨx duu vaik ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Merari gu Moisees gu Aaroon bhaan jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Israeel ja'tkam vaak gu vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' dɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jiix bɨɨx ka'm mambhɨɨx bɨx na ba' mambhɨɨx gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Moisees jix bɨɨx duu maa'n bhaan; gio ba' na ja'p ka't jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' bɨx gakiidha' bɨx ɨ'ra'n bɨx bhaan jix koi.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' yooxi'; na gu' cham yooxi' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' yooxi'; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees jix duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'ñdha' bɨx uañi'ñ gu chichio'ñ bhaan jix duñia' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jixchamaam bhaan mii' dhɨr bhaan uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ cham palhɨɨp jir bɨx bhai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ maa'n gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨx tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'x ka't; gio ba' no'x jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ oi'ñdha' tu' jix duñia' bhaan.
Na oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' baas bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ cham buupui jix duñia' tu' bhɨɨya' ñi'ookdham bhaan tu' bhɨɨya' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' tu' daraibu' bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam palhɨɨp gu u'vɨ; gio ba' daraibu' bhaan gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ palhɨɨp gu u'vɨ cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Epa kai' vaas; gio ba' cham bhaan bɨ'ñdhatu' tu' bhaan kubhion; na gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' chɨ'ñchoka' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu suudai' abhaar vaaso bhi'ñ; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gio jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan oo' bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu suudai'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook tɨɨt gu u'vɨ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios mo'o gu u'vɨ bhaan gu noobh; gio ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu novɨ gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim mu'ai.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook bɨndak tu' cham tu' gu chio'ñ namkidhat dhi' gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mu'ai.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ tu' oi'ñdha' bhɨɨya' jix duñia' bɨndak mai' gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook mu'ai gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa mu'ai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' vook tu'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu Dan mu'ai kapbhai' ba'k xoi'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vook; gio ba' gu u'vɨ; mi' dhɨr gu Ameen gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam u'uan bɨɨx gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' maa'n i'i gu u'vɨ gu suudai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix duñia' mu'ai; gio ba' gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mu'ai jɨjɨkgɨm gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu novɨ gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chɨ'ñchoka' bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan mi' dhɨr maa'n i'i gu suudai' gu u'vɨ.

Jano' ba' maa'n i'i gu suudai'; gio ba' ka't tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu chio'ñ gu suudai' mu'ai jɨjɨkgɨm gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim vook; mi' dhɨr gu u'vɨ ka't mu'ai tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Gu' gu' tu' gu u'vɨ cham ua'tulhi'ñ gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na jix bhai' ka't namkidhat ka't.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na pai' dhuuk gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ palhɨɨp gu u'vɨ; gio ba' jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ ka't namkidhat gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk bhaan gu Nasareo na ba' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' u'va; gio ba' jɨ'ɨɨk suudai' u'va tu' jɨ'ɨɨk cham i'i tu' i'i tu' jugi jix bhai'x tu' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx duñia' suudai' u'va dɨr bɨɨx ka'm cham jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu ñi'ook bhaan mo'o bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu tanoolh gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ka't; mi' dhɨr kiicha' gu ñi'ook mo'o.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook muukix.
Na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu taat tu' gu naan xibhɨk tu' gu ja'tkam cham bɨɨx na pai' dhuuk vaak jodai; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios juraa'n bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' oi'ñdha' vaak jodai gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x ju'ñdharan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mo'o; na ba' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh mo'o; mi' dhɨr kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu ñi'ook gook jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan; gio ba' uañi'ñ bhaan jix koi jix bhaan mo'o mii' dhɨr gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu tanoolh mar kaneer oi'ñga' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tanoolh dharka' ka't na gu' ka't.
Jano' ba' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Nasareo gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ɨlhdham ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios mar kaneer oi'ñga' cham maa'nkar tai bhaan ali' karneer oi'ñga' cham gu ñi'ook cham gu maa'nkar.

Na pai' dhuuk gu' na pai' dhuuk kuichdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' tu' chiñia' ɨɨbhidham gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' ka't oi'ñga' gook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook gu ñi'ook toov vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii; gio ba' gu ñi'ook toov oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan.

Na gu' duukat no'ñ tu' gu chuukug na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam na gu' tu' bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug.
