Jano' ba' cham ka't jano' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi vook gu naan tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' jano'.

Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; na gu' tu' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a kɨɨv gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr ka't jix duñia' mai' vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia ka't jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jum daa'ñ gu Mariia.
Jano' ba' gu Mariia ka't jix duñia' vaak ja'tkam kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' bɨɨx ka'm jum daa'ñ gu Mariia.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu aserot yooxi' oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu chichio'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' bopxi'ñ tattat gu chio'ñ maa'n gɨ'kora' ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees bhañ dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan jurtu'nka' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ jix duñia' chiñia' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suulhgia'; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Rubeen gu Sammua gu mar gu Sakkur.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon gu Sapat gu mar gu urii.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Issakâr gu Igal gu mar gu Josep.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Epraim gu Oseas gu mar gu Nun.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Palti gu mar gu Rapu.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Sabuloon gu Gaddiel gu mar gu Sodi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Josee bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu Gaddi gu mar gu Susi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Dan gu Ammiel gu mar gu Gemalli.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Aser gu Setur gu mar gu Mikâel.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Neptalii gu Naabii gu mar gu Bapsi.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Gad gu Geuel gu mar gu Makî.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Moisees bhañ gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Oseas gu mar gu Nun jix dhaas gu Moisees gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Josuee.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Kanaan tu ñi'ook; gio ba' saagi'ñ gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook jix duñia'; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix daa tu' jix kavɨk jix bhai'x tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix bhai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh jix duñia' tu' vaak zel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tu' cham tu'x jai'ch cham gu u'u; gio ba' gu i'bhɨ; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook tumiiñku.
Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Sin bɨɨx ka'm gu Reob baakɨk gu Emat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam saagi'ñ tɨɨtɨs bɨɨx ka'm gu ebroon; gio ba' mi'p gu Aimaan gu Sesai gu Talmai gu ma'nkam gu Anak; mi' dhɨr gu ebroon ka't kɨɨv va'k gu Soaan gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm jix duu gu Eskol gu ñi'ook bɨɨx aichdhak gook.
Jano' ba' jup tɨɨt mii' dhɨr pai' gu Naal-eskol gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' suulh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' oo'm gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu Paraan gu Kades jix maa bɨx gu i'bhɨ gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p; gio ba' no'ch gu oidha' gu ñi'ook bii'm suudai' na jix bhai'; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu i'bhɨ.
Gu' gu' gu ja'tkam jix daa mii' dhɨr gu oidha' jix kavɨk jɨ'dɨlh gu bhóogɨt jix kavɨk; gio ba' gio gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Anak.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' saagi'ñ; gio ba' gu eteo gu Jebuseo gu Amorreo gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Kananeo ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu Jordaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Kaleb jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Moisees; gio ba'; na.
Gu' gu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gui'p; gio ba' cham bhaan mii' dhɨr gu ja'tkam; na gu' jix kavɨk no'ch.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' bham; gio ba' gu oidha' pai' na ba' pai' gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu ja'tkam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chichio'ñ jix gɨ' dhi'; jano' ba' gio gu ma'nkam gu Anak; gio ba' jɨɨ'ñdhat no'ch chulhiiñdha' na ja'p gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix maa jiiñak; gio ba' gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr gu tukaa'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Moisees bhaan gu Aaroon bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' jix aa' bɨx; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook vaak jodai gu oidha' gu Ejipto; jano' ba' dhi' oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu oidha' na ba' biiñor gu u'vɨ biiñor ka't cham tutkɨ gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' am:―Ja'pji maa'n; gio ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Aaroon ia'rɨ bhaan gu vupui vupui bhaan bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' jajannulhi'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' na ba' gu oidha' jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch dhi' gu oidha' kapbhai'; gio ba' gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bhaan gu Jawatan Dios tu' ɨɨbhi'ñdha' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' na gu' chulhiiñdha' gu takarui'; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx no'ch gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr cham ɨɨbhi'ñdha'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jodai; gu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm duuk cham tu' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨx buimɨk gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bhaan gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios na gu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix buusñi dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu kavɨk.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu oidha'; gio ba' jix duñia' naak tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam gu vupui tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios toov ka't bhaan gu tanoolh vupui bhaan toov gu tukaa' gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook koi dhi' gu ja'tkam na ja'p gu chio'ñ; gio ba' chɨbɨɨp gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naak gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu ñi'ook bham.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios dhi' gu ja'tkam gu oidha' ka't gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' jano' tu' soi'ñ ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Jawatan na ja'p tu ñi'ook bham.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ cham gu ñi'ook; na jix duñia' tu' na cham jir bhai' tattat bhaan gu ma'nkam bɨɨx ka'm gu tanoolh bɨɨx ka'm jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jano' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch na ja'p dhi' gu ja'tkam dɨr gu Ejipto bɨɨx ka'm.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu' gu ñi'ook tu' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha'.
Na bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɇ'kamtu'nda' buimɨk gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto oidha' jix gaki jix duñia' oilhimɨk tu' mambhɨɨx mui'kim cham jix duñia' naak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' tattat; gio ba' cham jix duñia'.
Na gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu duukam gu Kaleb na gu' ka't gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu oidha' pai' chɨbiapui gu kai' makia' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' jano' xoi'kam gu Amalekita gu Kananeo gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix maat gu xibh oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx ka'm duuk tu jiim dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak jodai bhaan tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan jix duñia' maatɨt tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' oidha' jix gaki gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug; gio ba' bɨx bhaan bɨx jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jiix jix duñia' vaak jodai bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'r cham ba'k gu oidha' gu novɨ jix duñia'; gio ba' gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu' jix maati' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chuukug dhi' oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki oo'm bɨɨx ka'm gu chuukug ka't oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tanoolh oo'm gu tanoolh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook oo'm oi'ñga' gu tanoolh; gio ba' sɨlhka'n.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx dhi' jix maat tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr dhi' oidha' jix gaki ka't koi.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ gu Moisees bhañ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu ñi'ook vaak jodai bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook mii' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook cham bhai' gu oidha' jix koko' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu oidha' tɨjɨɨ'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu oidha'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees dhi' tu'x bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai'.
Jano' ba' jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk bham; gio ba' na ba' jix tɨ'ɨ pai' tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' uañi'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios dhi' xoi'kam.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tɨjɨɨ'ñ cham vupui bhaan obhɨɨ'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' gu Amalekita gu Kananeo vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook cham ka't gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk; gu' kaax na jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees cham jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jix dhaav gu Amalekita gu Kananeo oi'ñka' mii' dhɨr gu kavɨk tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ka'm gu orma.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar aagak na ba' duñia' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios kakneer.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu Epa bɨɨx gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar mar kaneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duu gook gu ñi'ook bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx vaik gu ñi'ook bɨɨx tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu vaakax gu ñi'ook mar kaneer kakneer gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jurtu'nka' jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx maa'n bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' tu'x na ba' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook ja'tkam mii' dhɨr no'x tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook tu' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook kavɨk gui'x gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam mii' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk ka't; mi' dhɨr na ja'p gu ñi'ook ka't jix duñia' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu ñi'ook gui'x gu ñi'ook jix duñia' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' tu'.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk kua'da' jugi gu takarui' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' maa'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu takarui' gu maa'nkar; gio ba' na ja'p gu maa'nkar ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham bɨx dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' bɨx tu'x gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Moisees dɨr gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix jix duñia'.

Jano' ba' ka't tu' uañi'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook maa'nkar tai bhaan gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga; gio ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; na gu' ka't na gu'; mi' dhɨr gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' bɨx gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook oi'ñga'.
Na pai' dhuuk jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook uañi'ñ na pai' dhuuk vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ka't.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook na tu a'ga gui'x na ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.
Gu' gu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ na ja'p ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix maa gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook ka't bhaan.
Jano' ba' kua' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u gu tanoolh juanda'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'u aichdhak gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas kuupa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham ka't jix duñia' gu ñi'ook duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu jodai bɨx gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu jodai jix koi; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jajannulhi'ñ gu ma'nkam; gio ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk tu duu tu' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim na ba' na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' jix duñia' tu duukam; gio ba' cham gu i'ii'ñ gu vupui.
Na ba' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook jɨɨgi'ñdham gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Ejipto na ba' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Koree gu mar gu Isar gu mar gu Koat gu mar gu Lebii; gio ba' gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; mi' dhɨr gu on gu mar gu Pelet gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen jix bhɨɨ gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix búup bhaan gu Moisees bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel chiñia' gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu tɨɨgɨ'.

Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon gui'p; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu' bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kai gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' gu Koree bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' gu xibh gu Jawatan Dios chɨkka jix bhaan jix maat; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi'; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Koree bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu xibh; gio ba' ka't gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix bhaan; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu Koree; gio ba' jix duñia' jano' gu ma'nkam gu Lebii.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duu tu' gu ñi'ook tu' bɨx gu ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Lebii bɨndak; na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bɨx bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu Aaroon gu ñi'ook na ba' bhaan vaak jodai.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees tɨɨt gu Dataan gu Abiram gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; gu' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham tu'x jai'ch gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook na ba' koi oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gio tu' no'ch.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu oidha' bii'm gu ñi'ook tu' jix maa dɨppɨr oi'ñga'n oidha' u'va; gio ba' gu vupui dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ cham.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees bhaam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai'.
Ba' jix aa' mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Koree; gio ba' tu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu xibh vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; mi' dhɨr tu' gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n vaak na jix bhaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios maa'n vaak na jix bhaan; gio ba' mambhɨɨx; mi' dhɨr tu' gio gu Aaroon maa'n bɨɨx vaak na jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ maa'n vaak na jix bhaan jix dhaas gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu Moisees gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Koree ka't gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' jano' ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bɨx gu chuukug cham gu chio'ñ jix duñia' tu' bhaan bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu abla gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu Koree gu Dataan gu Abiram.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix búup ka't gu Dataan gu Abiram; gio ba' daraa gu Israeel jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jano' vaak zel dhi' ja'tkam jix bhai'x gu chichio'ñ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam matgɨm gu ñi'ook cham bɨx uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu Koree gu Dataan gu Abiram; gio ba' gu Dataan gu Abiram moor jix dhaas kiki'ñgob vaak zel bɨɨx gu u'vɨ gu ma'nkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios tu' na ba' bɨx dhi' tu'x; na cham gu i'ii'ñ.
Jano' ba' tu' na ja'p kuusdaidha' bɨx gu chichio'ñ vaak jodai suulhgia' tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios cham bhañ.
Gu' gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu chin bɨɨx bɨx tu'x ko'iix jix dhaam suudai' jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu chichio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't a'gidhimɨk ñiokda' bɨx dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' ka't bɨtaa'n.
Jano' ba' jix kupi'ook gu oidha' gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak bɨx gu chichio'ñ gu Koree bɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨɨx bɨx ko'kmarak jix dhaav ko'iix jix dhaam suudai' jix bhaan dhaas gu oidha' jix koi tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu Israeel mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jiboi'ññor gu ñi'ook; na gu' am:―Ja'pji; mi' dhɨr cham gio gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' jix buus gu tai gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gu chichio'ñ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu' gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai; na gu'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' ja'tkam u'ua'tulhdhix bhaan gu i'ii'ñ; gio ba' jix duu na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; na gu' bɨɨx vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' ka't nɨi'ñchudat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx; gio ba' jix duñia' na ba' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.

Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tanoolh na jix bhai' cham ka't gu kai' gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na gu' cham ka't na ja'p gu Koree na ja'p; gio ba' bhaan jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu novɨ gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tanoolh buimgidhak bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak jodai bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham; gio ba' jix duñia' jix koi gu ja'tkam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' ka't na ja'p jum daa'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut toov ka't jix bhaan dhaas jix ñi'ñ gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Moisees gu Aaroon vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi'; gio ba' bhaan.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu ñi'ook vaak na jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai jodai maa'nkar Jawatan bhaan tu' jootom gu vupui; na gu' i'iich tu' gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui gu Jawatan Dios; jano' ba' tu' kua'da'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon vaak na jix bhaan na ja'p gu Moisees dai'bus tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' ka't kua'da' gu ja'tkam; mi' dhɨr jix dhaas tu' jix duu gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jix dhaas tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam ko'iix; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' jix koko' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu ñi'ook mambhɨɨx gɨ' cham koko'kam gu Koree.
Na pai' dhuuk mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu Moisees ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na pai' dhuuk ka't jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak tattat bɨx chiñia' jurtu'nka' gu vaak tattat; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' maa'n bhaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Aaroon bhaan gu Lebii; na gu' mo'o ja'tkam vaak tattat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut vupui bhaan chuut pai' tu'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu chio'ñ tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' bhaan tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx vaak jodai bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx chiñia' jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu vaak tattat bɨx; mi' dhɨr gu Aaroon ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tanoolh buimgidhak suudai' u'va gu Moisees vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon gu vaak gu Lebii ka't baas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix buusñi gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon vupui bhaan chuut na ba' nɨi'ñchudat gu ma'nkam; na gu' jix duu bhaan tu' na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees; gio ba' na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios jix duu.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu ñi'ook gu Moisees bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam no'ch gu'ch koko'kam gu'ch bɨx no'ch gu'ch.
Jano' ba' no'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios koi; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix koi bɨx.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu vaak gu taat bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ xidhuu; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak uañi'ñ jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' gu ja'tkam gio bopxi'ñ gu Lebii bopxi'ñ gu taat tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jum daa'ñ bɨndak jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak vupui bhaan vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' nukadham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; na gu' gu' cham jɨɨgi'ñdham tu' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na gu' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨndak jix duñia' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨx vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan; gio ba' gu tanoolh na jix bhai' tu' bhaan.
Jano' ba' gui'x jix nukadham xidhuu jix nukadham jodai maa'nkar Jawatan na ba' cham ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam gu Lebitas tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.

Gu' gu' tu' gu ma'nkam bɨndak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan bɨx jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia'; gio ba' tu' jix maa jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu tanoolh na jix bhai' koi.

Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu Miren tu' jix maa gio jix nukadham maa'nkar na jix maa; mi' dhɨr bɨx tu'x gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' jix maa gu ma'nkam ñi'ook kavɨk.

Jano' ba' dhi' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu tai; gio ba' bɨx gu maa'nkar bɨx uañi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook jix duñia' ka't gu bhóogɨt abhaar na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' xidhuu jugi; gio ba' bɨx gu chio'ñ jugi; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam abhaar ka't na ba' tu'.

Jano' ba' dhi' gio ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gu maa'nkar juana' bɨx maa'nkar na jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa tu' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak ñi'ook kavɨk; mi' dhɨr bɨx gu vaak jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨ'ñdhatu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tiriik bɨx gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix maa.
Jano' ba' gu ux na tu ibai' bɨx tu'x gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios ka't; gio ba' bɨx gu vaak jugi.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel ka't.

Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chuukug gu Jawatan Dios gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax ka't; gu' bɨx tu jiim maa'nkam mar gu chio'ñ; mi' dhɨr gio jix duu tu jiim maa'nkam mar gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duu jurtu'nka' u'uuk jixchamaam xidhuu gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook maa'nkam mar kaneer maa'nkam mar gu ñi'ook cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba'; mi' dhɨr gu ɨ'ɨr bhaan jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' na ja'p baaso na ja'p tu jiim ka't.

Jano' ba' bɨx maa'nkar na jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios jix maa na ba' tu' na ba' gu ma'nkam na ba' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ bɨndak ñi'ook kavɨk; gio ba' ñi'ook na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ba' tu' na ba' gu kai' bɨndak.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon; gio ba' gu oidha' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar tu' tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n; mi' dhɨr gu Yo jix duñia' baasɨ'n gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix maa gu ma'nkam gu Lebii bɨx boosgi gu Israeel gu maa'nkar na gu' tu jiim vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut na gu' cham uañi'ñ.
Gu' gu' gu Lebitas jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut gu ñi'ook; gio ba' ñi'ook kavɨk oidha' maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr cham gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Na gu' na gu' gu Lebitas jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar boosgi gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar; gio ba' tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham gu maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Lebitas daipu'; na pai' dhuuk gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu ma'nkam gu Israeel boosgi jix maa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios mambhɨɨx boosgi.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar na ja'p kai'ñ ka't na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gio gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios bɨx boosgi dho'ñchidhak gu ma'nkam gu Israeel; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' bɨx juana' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' bɨx tutkɨ tu'.
Jano' ba' daipu'; na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ ka't jix duñia' gu Lebitas gu i'bhɨ ka't na ja'p gu i'bhɨ.
Jano' ba' jugi gu ñi'ook pai' gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tutkɨ cham uañi'ñ; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu'x jix bhaan Gɨ'kora' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham koi.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bham; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel tu' gu ñi'ook cham ka't uañi'ñ bhaan cham ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mai' yooxi' jix maat.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu ñi'ook vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bɨɨx gu ɨ'ɨr kɨɨv mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu chuukug gu ɨ'ɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gɨ' u'u kavɨk tu' gu ñi'ook tu jiim jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tai gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gio gu chuukug bɨɨx gu suudai' mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam; gio ba' ka't ñaanbi' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ gu suudai' gio jix duñia' gu suudai' gu chuukug ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatai gu ñi'ook mai' yooxi' pai' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' gu suudai'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maatai gu ñi'ook jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai; gio ba' ka't gu ma'nkam gu Israeel ja'tkam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ ñi'ook kavɨk.
Na kuichdha' jix koi no'x gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaik gu tanoolh bɨɨx gu suudai' kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't na jix bhai'; gio ba' tu' vaik gu tanoolh cham ka't kɨɨv gu tanoolh.

Jano' ba' no'x kuichdha' jix koi gu ñi'ook gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix koi cham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu Israeel; na gu' gu suudai' cham ka't jix duñia' bhaan ñaanbi' ka't; jano' ba' ka't bhaan.
Na pai' dhuuk dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga na ba' na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' vaak jodai vaak zel; gio ba' no'x ba'k vaak zel bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ñaanbi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' bɨx vaaso jix kupi'ook bhaan cham bhɨɨya' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' no'x kuichdha' jix koi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu vupui yooxi' jix koi o'o gu ja'tkam tukga'n kɨɨv gu tanoolh ka't ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' na ba' ñaanbi' jix bhɨɨ maatai vaak na jix bhaan gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu suudai' gu tai vaaso.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ na jix bhai' jix bhɨɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' bhaan vaak zel bhaan bɨx bhaan mii' dhɨr bhɨɨya' dhaa o'o jix koi tukga'n.
Jano' ba' na jix bhai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan ñaanbi' vaik kɨɨv gu tanoolh; na pai' dhuuk gu tanoolh kɨɨv jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' bɨɨx gu suudai' ka't gu xumai.

Na gu' ua'tulhi'ñ ñaanbi' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' gu ñi'ook ka't tɨjɨɨ'ñ na gu' vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' cham ka't jix duñia' bhaan gu suudai'; mi' dhɨr ñaanbi'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ñi'ook kavɨk; gio ba' gio gu suudai' jix duñia' jajannulhi'ñ; mi' dhɨr kuichdha' gu suudai' ka't ñaanbi' bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' bɨx ñaanbi' kuichdha' ka't ñaanbi'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook kuichdha' ka't gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a bɨɨx ka'm gu xumai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu Sin maa'n gu ja'tkam gu Kades; gio ba' jix koi gu Mariia ka't.
Jano' ba' na ja'p cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' na ba' gu ñi'ook jum daa'ñ bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam bɨɨx gu Moisees tu ñi'ook bham; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook no'ch jix koi na pai' dhuuk xibhɨk gu ja'tkam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix ai gu Jawatan Dios dhi' oidha' jix gaki na ba' vaak jodai no'ch gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto na ba' dhi' cham bhai' pai' cham pai' gu ñi'ook tu'; gio ba' tu' gu suudai' na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu Moisees gu Aaroon vupui bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut bhaan gu vupui; gio ba' gɇ'kamtu'nda' gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu Aaroon xibhɨk tu ñi'ook gu jodai' na jix uam gu vupui; gio ba' maa'n gu suudai' jix buusñi gu suudai' gu jodai' na jix uam maa'n i'i gu ñi'ook gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhɨɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix.
Ba' jix aa' jum daa'ñ gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu jodai' na jix uam; gio ba' jix duñia' jano'; mi' dhɨr bhaan jix buus gu suudai' dhi' gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu novɨ tu' naaka'n gu jodai' na jix uam bɨɨx gook mui'kim; gio ba' moor mumua'da' gu suudai' jix i'i gu ñi'ook gu vaakax.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon; na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' gu vupui gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook cham dhi' gu oidha' jix maa.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu suudai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios jix bhaan duu.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ'kora' gu Edom dɨr gu Kades; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Israeel xibhɨk; mi' dhɨr tu' bɨx tu jiim tu' tɨbiap.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook taata'n tattat jix dhaav gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu Egipkios taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' duuñ gu Jawatan Dios jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhañ nobii'ñ jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' dhi' gu Kades kiicham.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; gio ba' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook oidha' u'va tu' i'i gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam cham kɨɨ'n tu' bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Edom jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gui'p; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu bhóogɨt bia'kat; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' tu' u'uuk; jano' ba' gu ñi'ook cham bhaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix buus gu Edom bhaan bɨɨx jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jix ai'chdhix gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kades gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tɨɨtɨs gu kavɨk gu or.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Aaroon gu kavɨk gu or gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' gu Edom bham.
Jano' ba' gu Aaroon ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; na gu' cham gu oidha' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Aaroon gu Eleasar gu mar tu jiim jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu or.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon jajannulhi'ñ jix duñia' gu Eleasar gu mar; na gu' gu Aaroon ka't gu ja'tkam koi.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix; gio ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu kavɨk gu or gu vupui bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aaroon jajannulhi'ñ gu Eleasar gu mar; gio ba' gu Aaroon jix koi gu kavɨk; mi' dhɨr gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix dhaav gu kavɨk.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Aaroon ka't jix koi jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh bɨx gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Oyendo gu Kananeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad jix daa saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Israeel jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' tu' kɨɨsa' dhi' gu ja'tkam gu novɨ tu' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel do'ñcho gu Kananeo jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jup tɨɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' mii' dhɨr pai' gu orma.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu kavɨk gu or gu bhóogɨt gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo na ba' gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Edom; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu bhóogɨt.

Ba' jix aa' gu ja'tkam bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto na ba' vaak jodai dhi' oidha' jix gaki tu' cham tu'x jai'ch gu takarui' tu' gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ juraa'n dhi' gu takarui' jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios bhañ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam gu ko'oi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam; gio ba' jix koi jix jai' gu ja'tkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ja'tkam suudai' u'va gu Moisees gui'p; gio ba' uañi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam a'ga tu ñi'ook bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhaan tu'; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios no'ch dhi' gu ko'oi; jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ko'oi jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr ka't no'x ua'tulhi'ñ ii'mdagaram.

Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu ko'oi gu jodai' na jix uam jix dhaas bhaan gu ñi'ook; na pai' dhuuk ka't na pai' dhuuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ko'oi gu tanoolh na jix bhai' oi'ñdha' gu ko'oi gu jodai' na jix uam.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Obot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Obot gu Ije-abarim oidha' jix gaki vupui bhaan gu Moab gu tas.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Sared.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baasɨ'n gu Arnoon oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo; na gu' gu Arnoon gu ñi'ook gu Moab tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Moab gu Amorreo.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook u'uan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix duu gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo gu Arnoon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ar gu ñi'ook gu Moab.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Beer; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix aa' gu Moisees; mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jiiñ gu Israeel dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan; gio ba' chiñia' gu ja'tkam bɨɨx; mi' dhɨr oidha' jix gaki tɨɨtɨs gu Matana.
Jano' ba' gu Matana gu Naaliel; gio ba' gu Naaliel gu Bamot.
Jano' ba' gu Bamot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak ja'tkam gu Moab gu Pisga tu jiim gu Jesimoon.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' cham tu' oidha' u'va; mi' dhɨr cham i'i gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt vaak ja'tkam bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook.

Gu' gu' gu Seoon cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu ñi'ook; gio ba' va'k jum daa'ñ gu Seoon bɨx gu ja'tkam jix buus bhaan gu Israeel oidha' jix gaki; mi' dhɨr suudai' u'va gu Jaas bhaan gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' naaka'n gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii jix bhɨɨ gu oidha' dɨr gu Arnoon bɨɨx ka'm gu Jabok bɨɨx ka'm gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon; na gu' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Ammoon ka't jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ gu Israeel bɨx dhi' jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' jix daa gu Israeel bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu Amorreo gu esboon bɨx taañpu'.

Na gu' na gu' gu esboon ka't kiicham gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos; gio ba' ka't jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham va'k bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm gu Arnoon.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu esboon kiicham gu Seoon.
Na gu tai jix buus gu esboon mɨmɨim kiicham gu Seoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ar gu Moab gu Jawatan gu Arnoon.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu Moab gu Perekido gu ja'tkam gu Kêmos; gio ba' jix dhaas gu ma'nkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos.
Gu' gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oi'dha' na gɨ'kora'; gio ba' gu esboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Diboon bɨɨx ka'm gu Nopa gu Medeba.
Jano' ba' jix daa gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' bhañ gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jaser; gio ba' gu ñi'ook taañpu' gu Amorreo ka't.
Jano' ba' suulh jix tɨ'ɨ gu bhóogɨt gu Basaan jix buus bhaan gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan bɨx gu ja'tkam na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edrei.

Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ɨɨbhi'ñ gu novɨ jix maa bɨx gu ja'tkam gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr jix duu na ja'p gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreos jix daa gu esboon.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam bɨx gu ja'tkam cham maa'n gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam gu Moab dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor bɨx gu Israeel ka't gu ñi'ook gu Amorreo.
Jano' ba' gu Moab gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix jai' kuiñcha gu ja'tkam ka't jix jai'; gio ba' jix duñia' gu Moab kuiñcha gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moab daraa gu Madiaan; gio ba' jano' jix duñia' dhi' gu ja'tkam bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p jix duñia' gu vaakax yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor ka't jano' ba' gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab.

Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhañ gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu Petor ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu ja'tkam na ba' mɨmɨim bham; gio ba' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha' jix daa vupui bhaan tu'.
Na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' tu' soi'ñ dhi' gu ja'tkam na gu' jix kavɨk tu'; gio ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu oidha'; na tu' ka't tu' ka't.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu daraa gu Moab daraa gu Madiaan bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Balaam gui'p gu ñi'ook gu Balak.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu tukaa' tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr chiñia' gu Moab bɨɨx gu Balaam.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ dhi' ja'tkam bɨndak.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' gu ñi'ook gu Ejipto jix duñia' gu vupui gu oidha'; gio ba' jano'; mi' dhɨr bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx tu' gu ja'tkam; na gu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh chiñia' gu Balak; na gu' gu oidha' na gu' gu Jawatan Dios cham tu' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' chiñia' gu Moab jix búup tɨɨtɨs gu Balak gui'p; gio ba' gu Balaam cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai bɨɨx no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balak tɨip jix duñia' chiñia'.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu Balaam gui'p; gio ba' tu ñi'ook gu Balak gu mar gu Sippor; mi' dhɨr jix duñia' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix ai tu'.
Na gu' na gu' cham jix duñia' tu' nɨidhat jix jai' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tu ñi'ook; gio ba' jano' dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam tu duukam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balak koi gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix uam jodai cham bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bhaan tu' jix gɨ'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jano' dhi' gu tukaa' na ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam gu tukaa'; gio ba' gu Si gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mɨmɨim gu chichio'ñ bamii' tu' bɨɨx; gu' cham gu ñi'ook jix duu tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix búup gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu xibh gu ñi'ook ka't bɨɨx chiñia' gu Moab.
Na gu' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na gu'; gio ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gɨ' kavɨk bhaan gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gook.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt bɨɨx gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' jix ai'chdhix gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt tu' yooxi'; mi' dhɨr jano' ba' naaka'n gu Balaam gu ñi'ook na ba' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt.
Gu' gu' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' u'va ga'ra' baasɨ'n.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tɨɨt gu Balaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix dhaas pai' cham ka't gu bhóogɨt na ba' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n tu' kɨɨ'n tu'.
Jano' ba' ñɨi'ñ gu ñi'ook nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨtaa'n gu Balaam; gio ba' bhaam gu Balaam tu' naaka'n gu ñi'ook bɨɨx.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu chin gu ñi'ook gu Balaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' vaik mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu ñi'ook; na gu' tu' jix duñia' tu'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kuchii gu novɨ jano' tu' kooda'.

Ba' jix aa' gu ñi'ook gu Balaam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' gu ñi'ook bhaan tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr tu' bɨɨx ka'm dhi' gu tanoolh; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook duñia' bɨndak jix aa'; jano' ba' cham.

Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix kupi'ook gu vupui gu Balaam jix ñi' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu bhóogɨt ga'ra' gu kuchii gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ; gio ba' gu Balaam jix duu tu jiim tu' bhaan gu vupui.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dhi' vaik mui'kim tu' gu ñi'ook na ba' na gu' gu bhóogɨt jix bhai'x vupui bhaan tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tu' buupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' dhi' vaik mui'kim; gio ba' tu' cham tu' gio jano' tu' kooda' tu' gu tai.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balaam nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ cham bhai'x tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan tu' gu bhóogɨt; gu' jano' tu' gu ñi'ook cham bhai' tu'.
Ba' jix aa' nobii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios gu Balaam; gio ba' tu' bɨɨx jix duñia' gu chichio'ñ; gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; jano' ba' gu Balaam ka't bɨɨx chiñia' gu Balak.
Jano' ba' tɨiñ gu Balak gu Balaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix buus tu jiim kiicham gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu ñi'ook gu Arnoon.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' cham jix duñia' tu' mɨmɨim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook cham tɨbiap tu' cham tu' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa' gu Balak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' tɨbiap tu'; gu' jano' ñiokda' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chin tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' ka't gu Balaam bɨɨx gu Balak tɨɨtɨs kiicham gu usot.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Balak kooda' gu vaakax kakneer bhañ gu Balaam chiñia' mi'p bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tanoolh buimgidhak gu Balak jix bhɨɨ gu Balaam tu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Baal dɨr jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak jix duu na ja'p gu Balaam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balak gu Balaam tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' tu jiim; mi' dhɨr gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham no'x tu'; jano' ba' ka't.
Ba' jix aa' suudai' u'va gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balaam; gio ba' kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan jix duñia' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan tuur gu ñi'ook.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu chin gu Balaam; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balak ñiokda'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨx chiñia' gu Moab.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Aram gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balak gu gɨ'kora' gu Moab gu kakkavɨk tas buusñi; mi' dhɨr gu Jakob; jano' ba' gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tu' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios cham tu'.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dɨr; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham ka't jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu ñi'ook oo' gu Jakob jɨɨ'ñdhidha' gu ñi'ook baasɨ'n gu Israeel gu Muera gu ñi'ook koi'm gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ja'p.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' na ba' obhɨɨ'ñ jix bhai' aa'.
Ba' jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Jawatan Dios gu chin na ba' a'ga.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai' dɨr jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook cham bɨx; jano' ba' dɨr.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Sopim gu Pisga kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan makgɨrxi tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan tu' tu jiim gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios jix buus gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balaam jix dhaas gu ñi'ook gu chin; gio ba' gu Balak a'ga.
Jano' ba' suudai' u'va gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't ju'ñdharan maa'nkar tai bhaan bɨɨx chiñia' gu Moab; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balak; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook tu' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Balak bamii' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jix kai gu ñi'ook gu mar gu Sippor.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios cham gu chio'ñ na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' tu' gu mar gu chio'ñ na ba'; mi' dhɨr jix aa' cham; jano' ba' tu ñi'ook cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' jix bhai' aa'; gio ba' jix bhai' aa' cham jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' cham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu Jakob tu' buupui gu ñi'ook gu Israeel; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu gɨ'kora'.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Na gu' na gu' gu Jakob cham cham tu'x jai'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu Israeel; gio ba' na ja'p jano' ka't tu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam na ja'p maavɨt jix búup na ja'p maavɨt; gio ba' cham bɨɨx ka'm gu ɨ'ɨr koko'kam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balak gu Balaam; na gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' cham tu' tu ñi'ook bɨx gu Jawatan Dios mii' dhɨr no'ñ bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak gu Balaam; gio ba' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' pai'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios dɨr.
Jano' ba' gu Balak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Balaam gu Peor tu jiim bhaan gu Jesimoon.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Balaam gu Balak; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kɨɨv jodai maa'nkar Jawatan kɨɨv ali' vaakax kɨɨv gu chuukug.
Ba' jix aa' gu Balak jix duu na ja'p gu Balaam; gio ba' makgɨrxi tuur gu ñi'ook jodai maa'nkar Jawatan.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix ñi' gu Balaam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam xoi'kam gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel cham ka't na ja'p gookim jix duñia' gu ñi'ook jix dhaas gu vupui bhaan oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vupui jix ñi' gu Israeel bopxi'ñ; gio ba' gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ gu Jawatan Dios suudai' u'va bhaan.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu chio'ñ gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu Omnipotente; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vaak zel gu ñi'ook gu Jakob gu ñi'ook gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p ju'ñdharan gɨ' suudai' jiim na ja'p gu ux na tu ibai' gu Jawatan Dios na ja'p gɨ' u'u kavɨk ju'ñdharan gu suudai'.
Jano' ba' gu noobh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu suudai' gu kai' ka't mumua'da' gu suudai'; gio ba' tu' gu gɨ'kora' gu Agag oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' ka't.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix buusñi gu Ejipto; gio ba' juraa'n tu' na jix kavɨk na ja'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; mi' dhɨr jugi chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook o'oo bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu ñi'ook na ja'p maavɨt na ja'p; gio ba' chɨkka gu Benditos tu'.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam daak gu Balak bhaan gu Balaam gu ñi'ook; na ba' tu jiim obhɨɨ'ñ tu' tɨɨgim tu' vaik mui'kim.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' pai'; gio ba' tu' tu ñi'ook tu' nɨidhat gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' nɨidhat.
Jano' ba' gu Balaam jix aa'; gio ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gio bham.

Jano' ba' tu' gu Balak koi gu vaak gu ñi'ook jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios na ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai' tu'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu ñi'ook gu ñi'ook tu'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jano' gu ja'tkam; na ba' tu' dhi' gu ja'tkam tu' duñia' gu ja'tkam gu tanoolh.
Ba' jix aa' jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix aa' gu Balaam gu mar gu Beor gu chio'ñ gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' jix kai tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Altiisimo jix ñi' gu ñi'ook gu Omnipotente; gio ba' gu' gu vupui.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu' cham jano'; gio ba' gu' cham mia'n; mi' dhɨr gu Estrella gu Jakob gu Israeel gu Moab bɨx gu ma'nkam gu Set.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Edom ka't gio gu Seir obhɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu Jakob gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam kiicham.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Amalek jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' gu Amalek mo'o chɨbɨɨp; gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Ba' jix aa' ñɨi'ñ gu Kineo jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; gio ba' jix kavɨk ba'bhak jix dhaas gu jodai' na jix uam gu ñi'ook.
Na pai' dhuuk gu Kineo ka't baas na pai' dhuuk gu Assur tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Ba' jix aa' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhɨɨ ua'rgidhak; na pai' dhuuk gu ñi'ook chɨkka ii'mdagaram na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios dhi' tu'x.
Jano' ba' aajim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Kittim gu Assur gio gu Eber; gu' gio gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx tas.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix búup gu Balaam ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam pai'; gio ba' gio gu Balak ka't gu bhóogɨt.
Jano' ba' jix utu'ñ gu Israeel gu Sittim gu ja'tkam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Moab.
Jano' ba' tɨɨt gu ja'tkam makgɨrxi'ñdha' gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix jugi tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu Baal-peor; gio ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees; gio ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx chiñia' gu ja'tkam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios vupui bhaan gu tas; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu Israeel.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel; gio ba' maa'n mii' dhɨr ja'tkam jix duñia' gu Baal-peor.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel suudai' u'va gu Madianita gu ja'tkam gu vupui gu Moisees bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel joi'ndam ki'ñgob vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut.
Jano' ba' jix ñi' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan jix búup tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook jix bhɨɨ u'u kavɨk gu novɨ.
Jano' ba' ka't bhaan gu chio'ñ gu Israeel vaak zel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ gu Israeel gu u'vɨ vook; gio ba' jix utu'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' jix koko' mii' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maakobh jix bhai'x.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.

Jano' ba' gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar gu mar gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam i'iich gu ma'nkam gu Israeel baabuk tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' tu' cham gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu'; gio ba' gu Miren tu' dhi' ñi'ook na jix bhaan bhai'x i'ii'ñ bɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kai' mi' dhɨr ñi'ook na jix bhaan jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; na gu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duu gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ jix koi ka't jix koi bɨɨx gu Madianita ka't gu Simri gu mar gu Salu gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu Simeoon.
Jano' ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' gu u'vɨ gu Madianita muukix ka't gu Kosbi mar u'vɨ gu Sur gɨ'kora' ja'tkam gu ja'tkam gu taat ja'tkam vaak gu Madiaan.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Madianitas.
Na gu' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx jix duñia' gu Peor gu Kosbi mar u'vɨ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Madiaan gu ja'tkam ka't muukix gu tanoolh kuiñcha gu Peor.
Ba' jix aa' ka't mi' dhɨr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu Eleasar gu mar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Aaroon bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook jiix gu vaak tattat bɨx jix buus bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan tu ñi'ook bɨɨx vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ja'tkam gu ñi'ook jiix na ja'p jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Ejipto.
Jano' ba' gu Rubeen maa'nkam mar gu Israeel; gio ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; mi' dhɨr gu anok ka't ja'tkam vaak gu anokîtas; jano' ba' gu Palluu ja'tkam vaak gu Palluitas.
Jano' ba' gu esroon ja'tkam vaak gu esronitas; gio ba' gu Karmi ja'tkam vaak gu Karmitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Rubenitas; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu oo'm vaik ja'tkam vaak gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Palluu; gio ba' gu Eliab.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Eliab; gio ba' gu Nemuel gu Dataan gu Abiram; na pai' dhuuk dhi' ja'tkam gu Dataan gu Abiram jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duu bhaan gu Moisees gu Aaroon bɨɨx chu'p gu Koree na pai' dhuuk bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk gu oidha' jix kupi'ook gu chin gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Koree na pai' dhuuk mii' dhɨr chu'p jix koi na pai' dhuuk gu tai mambhɨɨx gu chio'ñ jix bɨɨx duu nɨi'ñchudat.
Gu' gu' gu ma'nkam gu Koree cham jix koko'.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Nemuel ja'tkam vaak gu Nemuelitas; mi' dhɨr gu Jamiin ja'tkam vaak gu Jaminitas; jano' ba' gu Jakîn ja'tkam vaak gu Jakînitas.
Jano' ba' gu Sera ja'tkam vaak gu Seraitas; gio ba' gu Sauul ja'tkam vaak gu Saulitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Simeonitas gu ñi'ook gook ja'tkam vaak gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sepoon ja'tkam vaak gu Seponitas; mi' dhɨr gu Aggi ja'tkam vaak gu Aggitas; jano' ba' gu Suni ja'tkam vaak gu Sunitas.
Jano' ba' gu Osni ja'tkam vaak gu Osnitas; gio ba' gu Eri ja'tkam vaak gu Eritas.
Jano' ba' gu Aros ja'tkam vaak gu Aroditas; gio ba' gu Areli ja'tkam vaak gu Arelitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Gad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oo'm ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; gio ba' gu Er gu Onaan; mi' dhɨr gu Er gu Onaan jix koko' gu oidha' gu Kanaan.

Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sela ja'tkam vaak gu Selaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Pares ja'tkam vaak gu Paresitas; jano' ba' gu Sera ja'tkam vaak gu Seraitas.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Pares; gio ba' gu esroon ja'tkam vaak gu esronitas; mi' dhɨr gu amul ja'tkam vaak gu amulitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Judaa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Tola ja'tkam vaak gu Tolaitas; mi' dhɨr gu Puaa ja'tkam vaak gu Puanitas.
Jano' ba' gu Jasub ja'tkam vaak gu Jasubitas; gio ba' gu Simron ja'tkam vaak gu Simronitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Issakâr gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook maakobh ja'tkam vaak vaik.

Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Sabuloon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Sered ja'tkam vaak gu Sereditas; mi' dhɨr gu Eloon ja'tkam vaak gu Elonitas; jano' ba' gu Jalel ja'tkam vaak gu Jalelitas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Sabulonitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' gu Manasees gu Epraim.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Manasees; gio ba' gu Makîr ja'tkam vaak gu Makîritas; mi' dhɨr gu Makîr jix mar gu Galaad; jano' ba' gu Galaad ja'tkam vaak gu Galaaditas.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ma'nkam gu Galaad; gio ba' gu Jeser ja'tkam vaak gu Jeseritas; mi' dhɨr gu elek ja'tkam vaak gu elekitas.
Jano' ba' gu Asriel ja'tkam vaak gu Asrielitas; gio ba' gu Sekêm ja'tkam vaak gu Sekêmitas.
Jano' ba' gu Semida ja'tkam vaak gu Semidaitas; gio ba' gu eper ja'tkam vaak gu eperitas.
Jano' ba' gu Salpaad gu mar gu eper cham jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' gu tɨɨgɨ' ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad jix bɨɨx duu gu Maala gu Noa gu ogla gu Milka gu Tirsa.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam vaak gu Manasees; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx gook ja'tkam vaak.

Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' kɨɨv gu tanoolh kɨɨv ali' vaakax gook gu chuukug gu ñi'ook ali' karneer oi'ñga' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx ali' vaakax bɨɨx gu chuukug bɨɨx ali' karneer bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x gu tanoolh gui'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' matgɨm gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'nkar tai bhaan gu maa'nkar gu vaak na jix bhai' gu ñi'ook gu kakai' na mɨk tu da'a gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook kɨɨv ali' karneer oi'ñga' cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ali' karneer bhaan jɨɨ'ñdhidha' jurtu'nka' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.
Jano' ba' gu chio'ñ chiiw gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan gu vaak na jix bhai' bɨɨx gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba'.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook na ba' maa'nkar tai bhaan na ba' gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jurtu'nka' bɨx gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees chiñia' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia'.
Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk oi'ñdha' jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx cham gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jurtu'nka' bɨx jix buus gu chin.
Na pai' dhuuk gu' gu u'vɨ na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx gu vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' tu' gu taat jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu taat bɨx ka't jiimda' bɨx bɨɨx bhɨɨya' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' gu taat gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix duñia' bɨx bɨɨx bhɨɨya' gu i'ii'ñ cham ka't jiimda'; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñka' na gu' gu taat.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' ua'tulhi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' jix duñia' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ.
Na pai' dhuuk tu' gu chio'ñ jix duñia' na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't jiimda' bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu' tu' na pai' dhuuk gu chio'ñ jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñka'.
Gu' gu' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam na jix xoi'kam bɨɨx gu i'ii'ñ ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' bhɨɨya' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaak gu chio'ñ bhɨɨya' gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' tu' gu chio'ñ jix kai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam cham; gio ba' jano' ba' bɨx ka't jiimda' bɨx bɨɨx bhɨɨya' gu i'ii'ñ gu ñi'ook ka't.
Gu' gu' tu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jix kai; gio ba' bɨx jix buus gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ ka't; mi' dhɨr gu chio'ñ gu Jawatan Dios uañi'ñka'.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ gu chio'ñ.
Gu' cham gu ñi'ook tu' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tanoolh jano' ba' bɨx bhaan; na gu' gu tanoolh jix kai.

Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mi' dhɨr jix duñia' naak jano' ba' uañi'ñ; gio ba' dhi' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu chio'ñ gu u'vɨ tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu taat mar u'vɨ gu vaak gu taat.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu vupui gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bhaan gu Madianitas; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ka' gu ñi'ook gu ja'tkam.
Ba' jix aa' jano' ba' gu Moisees gu ja'tkam bham; gio ba' gu Armaos dhɨt gu ñi'ook na ba' bhɨɨ'ñdham tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Madiaan jix duu gu Jawatan Dios gu Madiaan.
Jano' ba' jix bhai'x bopxi'ñ bɨx bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel jix bhai'x bopxi'ñ jix bhai'x bhɨɨ'ñdham.

Jano' ba' gu Moisees bhañ bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' jix bhai'x bopxi'ñ bhañ; mi' dhɨr gu Pinees gu mar gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨɨx jɨɨgi'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu novɨ na ba' kuichdha'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu Madiaan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees mu'aa bɨx gu chio'ñ.

Jano' ba' mu'aa gio tɨjɨɨ'ñ koko'kam gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan; gio ba' gu Ebi gu Rekem gu Sur gu ur gu Reba jixchamaam gu gɨ'kora' gu Madiaan; mi' dhɨr gu Balaam gio gu mar gu Beor mu'aa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bhɨɨk gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu u'vɨ gu Madianitas gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax bɨx; gio ba' bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu tai bɨx jɨ'dɨlh taañpu'.
Jano' ba' jix bhɨɨ bɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu chichio'ñ na ja'p gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' aichdhak gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' moor gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan bɨx chiñia' gu ñi'ook tu jiim mai' yooxi'.
Jano' ba' bhaam gu Moisees bhaan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bhaan bopxi'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' bɨx gu u'vɨ jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bɨɨx duu gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Balaam na ba' bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu Peor; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' bɨx gu chio'ñ tɨjɨɨ'ñ a'aalh; gio ba' gio bɨx gu u'vɨ ka't gu chio'ñ.
Jano' ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu u'vɨ cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ na jix do'ig.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' yooxi' kɨɨv gu tanoolh; gio ba' bɨx gu ñi'ook no'x bhɨɨya' dhaa jix koi vaik kɨɨv gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx tɨi'chu' bɨx tɨɨt bɨx gu ñi'ook bɨx vaaso gu u'u.
Ba' jix aa' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham aajidha' bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' dhi' jir bɨx bhai' ñi'ook na tu a'ga gu Jawatan Dios tu' jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix uam jodai jix toja jodai gu jodai' na jix uam jix kavɨk jodai dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix duñia' gu tai gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tai gu ñi'ook ka't na jix bhai' xoi'kam gu suudai' jix duñia'; gu' gu ñi'ook gu suudai' bɨx cham gu oi'ñga'n gio gu suudai' gu tai.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jajannulhi'ñ kɨɨv gu tanoolh boopoya'; gio ba' mi' dhɨr ba'k yooxi'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu ñi'ook na ja'p gu vaakax tu' jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar ɨɨbhidham tattat gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ moor bhɨɨ'ñdham bɨx gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' gu Jawatan Dios namki'ñdha' gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham moor bhɨɨ'ñdham; gio ba' maa'n na ja'p gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' maa'n gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n mambhɨɨx gu vaakax gu ñi'ook kakneer bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n; gio ba' maa'n gu Lebitas namki' jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' jix duu gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jixchamaam jix bhai'x kakneer.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gook jix bhai'x gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu u'vɨ cham gu chio'ñ bɨx gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ baasɨ'n gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bhɨɨ'ñdham ka't jɨɨ'ñdhidha' vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x kakneer.
Jano' ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios kakneer ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jixchamaam.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x; gio ba' namki'ñdha' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gook.
Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees namki'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu Jawatan Dios gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix ai'chdhix gu Moisees gu chichio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ñi'ook ka't; gio ba' kakneer vaik gu ñi'ook kɨɨv jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix bhai'x.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix bhai'x gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x; gio ba'.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix bhɨɨ gu Moisees maa'n mambhɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p gu vaakax jix maa gu Lebitas ko'kmarak jix nukadham vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia' gu Moisees.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees mii' dhɨr ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham bopxi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gui'p gu Moisees; gio ba' tu duukam jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham chulhiiñdha' tu' no'ch.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios gu maa'nkar maa'n tu' gaagam jix uam jodai na ba' gu vupui gu ñi'ook gu i'ii'ñ vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Moisees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix uam jodai bɨx.
Jano' ba' bɨx jix uam jodai gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios bopxi'ñ ka't mambhɨɨx jix bhai'x mambhɨɨx.
Jano' ba' gu chichio'ñ ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam maa'n na ba'.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Eleasar jix uam jodai bopxi'ñ aichdhak vaak na tɨjɨɨ'ñ Jawatan chuut chɨ'ñchoka' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu ma'nkam gu Gad ko'kmarak gu bhóogɨt jix gɨ' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax; gio ba' ñɨi'ñ gu oidha' gu Jaser gu Galaad pai' gu vaakax.
Jano' ba' tɨɨtɨs gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu ñi'ook gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan chiñia' gu ñi'ook bham.
Jano' ba' gu Atarot gu Diboon gu Jaser gu Nimra gu esboon gu Eleale gu Sabaan gu Nebo gu Beoon.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios naaka'n vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu Israeel gu oidha' gu vaakax tu duukam namki' gu vaakax.
Na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p tu' bakia' nɨidhidha' gu vupui jix duñia' dhi' gu oidha' tu duukam gu maa'nkar cham gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan.
Jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen; gio ba' aajim gu ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham gu oidha' tu' jix maa gu Jawatan Dios.
Na pai' dhuuk jix duu tattat na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' dɨr gu Kades-barnea na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'.
Na jix tɨ'ɨ bɨɨx ka'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Eskol mi' dhɨr gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel na ba' cham gu oidha' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix maa.
Jano' ba' i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jano' ba' gu ñi'ook bham.
Na gu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu chio'ñ jix tɨ'ɨ gu Ejipto gu ñi'ook jiix gu oidha' gu Abraam gu Isaak gu Jakob na gu' cham jix bɨɨx duu tu'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone gu Keneseo gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun jix bɨɨx duu gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' jix duu i'iich gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Israeel tu' oo'm oidha' jix gaki bɨɨx ka'm ka't gu ñi'ook bɨx mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook cham bhai' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' pai' tattat gu chichio'ñ u'ua'tulhdhix na ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bhaan gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook jix duñia' oidha' jix gaki bɨx dhi' gu ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'p; gio ba' na ba' chulhiiñdha' gu vaakax jɨ'dɨlh na ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh.

Jano' ba' no'ch gu ñi'ook tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx ka'm pai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh jɨ'dɨlh jix kavɨk kuiñcha gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam baak gu vaak bɨɨx ka'm gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu maa'nkar.
Na gu' na gu' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu maa'nkar bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan tu' jix duñia' na gu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' gu maa'nkar dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu' na ba' tu' vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bɨɨx ka'm ka't baas obhɨɨ'ñ vupui bhaan.

Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' boopoya' gu ñi'ook na ba' bɨɨx gu Jawatan Dios na ba' bɨɨx gu Israeel; mi' dhɨr dhi' gu oidha' ka't gu maa'nkar vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam uañi'ñ gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' uañi'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jɨ'dɨlh na ba' a'aalh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ba' kakneer tu' gu ñi'ook gu chin.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu Moisees bham; gio ba' tu duukam jix duu na ja'p gu Jawatan tu' jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook a'aalh gu ñi'ook gu u'vɨ gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu ñi'ook gu vaakax no'm jɨ'dɨlh gu Galaad.
Jano' ba' tu duukam gu ñi'ook bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios bhɨɨ'ñdham gu Jawatan tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moisees gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun chiñia' tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Ba' jix aa' gu Moisees; gio ba' tu' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan gu ñi'ook bɨx bhɨɨ'ñdham vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios ua'tulhi'ñ vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Galaad gu maa'nkar.
Gu' gu' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook bɨɨx gu ñi'ook jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen tu ñi'ook bham; gio ba' chulhiiñchuda' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook tu duukam.
Jano' ba' no'ch gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Jawatan Dios gu oidha' gu Kanaan gu maa'nkar ka't dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan.

Jano' ba' jix maa gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Seoon gu gɨ'kora' gu Amorreo oi'dha' na gɨ'kora' gu Og gu gɨ'kora' gu Basaan gu oidha' bɨɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Gad gu ñi'ook gu Diboon gu Atarot gu Aroer.
Jano' ba' gu Atrot-sopan gu Jaser gu Jogbaa.

Jano' ba' mi'p gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Egipkios gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix koi bɨx maa'nkam mar; gio ba' dhaibu gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook gio ñi'ook na jir bhai' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu Rameses gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam yooxi' gu Sukkot.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Sukkot gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Etam oidha' jix gaki.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Pi-airot gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu gɨ' suudai' oidha' jix gaki gu bhóogɨt vaik gu tanoolh oidha' jix gaki gu Etam gu Mara.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Mara tɨɨtɨs gu Elim pai' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam suudai' buusñi gu suudai'; gio ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Elim ju'ñdharan gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu Bermejo oidha' jix gaki cham.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki cham gu Dopka.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Dopka gu Aluus.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Aluus gu Repidim pai' gu ja'tkam cham jix duñia' gu suudai' na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Repidim oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam oidha' jix gaki gu Sinaii gu Kibrot-ataaba.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Kibrot-ataaba gu aserot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu aserot gu Ritma.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Ritma gu Rimmoon-peres.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rimmoon-peres gu Libna.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Libna gu Rissa.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Rissa gu Keelata.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Keelata gu kavɨk gu Seper.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Seper gu arada.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu arada gu Makelot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Makelot gu Taat.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Taat gu Tara.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Tara gu Mitka.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Mitka gu asmona.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu asmona gu Moserot.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Moserot gu Bene-jaakaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Bene-jaakaan gu kavɨk gu Gidgad.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu Gidgad gu Jotbata.
