Jano' ba' jix tɨ'ɨ gu Aaroon jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu kavɨk gu or jurtu'nka' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix koi oo'm gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu oidha' gu Ejipto jixchamaam maa'n.
Na pai' dhuuk ka't gu Aaroon gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chamaam gu ñi'ook vaik na pai' dhuuk jix koi gu kavɨk gu or.
Jano' ba' gu Kananeo gu gɨ'kora' gu Arad jix daa saagi'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan jix kai na ja'p jix daa tɨbiap gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kavɨk gu or gu Salmona.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Salmona gu Punoon.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Almon-diblataim gu kakkavɨk gu Abarim vupui bhaan gu Nebo.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu kakkavɨk gu Abarim vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan dɨr gu Bet-jesimot bɨɨx ka'm gu Abel-sitim vaak ja'tkam gu Moab.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨx gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan bɨx.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n gu oidha'; na gu' tu' jix maa na ba'.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' mamai'chɨk ja'tkam vaak; gio ba' mui'x jix jai' gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook gu maa'nkar; na pai' maa'n; jano' ba' bopxi'ñ tattat.
Jano' ba' tu' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu vaakax soi'm na oi'ñga'n vupui bhaan ka't gu vupui jo'ii' tu jiim jix duñia' bhaan gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook na ja'p tu' duñia'.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk kia'mi'ñ gu oidha' gu Kanaan maachim gu oidha' tu' gu maa'nkar pai' gu Kanaan bhaan.
Jano' ba' gui'x gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ dɨr oidha' jix gaki gu Sin bɨɨx ka'm gu ñi'ook gu Edom; gio ba' ka't gu ñi'ook saagi'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' bhaan tas buusñi.

Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook dɨr saagi'ñ bɨɨx ka'm gu Akrabbim gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Sin; gio ba' ka't saagi'ñ gu Kades-barnea; mi' dhɨr gu asar-addar gu ñi'ook bɨɨx ka'm gu Asmoon.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Asmoon bɨɨx ka'm bhi'ñbak gu Ejipto gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't tas gei'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't gu gɨ' suudai'; gio ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook ka't dhi'; gio ba' dɨr gu gɨ' suudai' nɨi'ñchudat gu kavɨk gu or.
Jano' ba' gu kavɨk gu or nɨi'ñchudat ba'k gu amat ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu Sedad.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Sipoon ka't gu asar-enaan; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook tas buusñi nɨi'ñchudat dɨr gu asar-enaan bɨɨx ka'm gu Sepam.
Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Sepam gu Ribla tas buusñi gu Ain; gio ba' jix dhaav gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu gɨ' suudai' gu Kinneret tas buusñi.
Jano' ba' mi' dhɨr jix dhaav dhi' gu ñi'ook gu Jordaan ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu gɨ' suudai' gu Salado; gio ba' dhi' ka't gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr gu ñi'ook xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bham; gio ba' dhi' gu oidha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios koi gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ ɨraab bopxi'ñ.
Na gu' na gu' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Rubeen bhaan gu vaak tattat bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Gad bhaan gu vaak tattat ɨraab bopxi'ñ gu Manasees jix duñia' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam.
Jano' ba' gook bopxi'ñ ɨraab jix bhɨɨ gu maa'nkar dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo tas buusñi gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu tas.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha'; gio ba' gu Eleasar jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu Josuee gu mar gu Nun.
Jano' ba' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gio bopxi'ñ gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' na ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu tɨɨgɨ' gu chio'ñ; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu Judaa gu Kaleb gu mar gu Jepone.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Simeoon gu Samueel gu mar gu Ammiud.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu Benjamiin gu Elidad gu mar gu Kisloon.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Dan gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Bukki gu mar gu Jogli.
Jano' ba' gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu aniel gu mar gu Epod.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Epraim gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Kêmuel gu mar gu Siptaan.

Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Issakâr gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Paltiel gu mar gu Asan.
Jano' ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Aser gu gɇ'kam na ja jɨɨ'ñdha' gu Aiud gu mar gu Selomi.

Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo bham.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix maa gu Lebitas gu maa'nkar jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; gio ba' gio gu Lebitas jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh xikoolh.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh na ba' jix daa gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam ka't na ba' gu vaakax na ba' bɨx gu vaakax.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' kiicham baasɨ'n tas buusñi gook jix bhai'x baasɨ'n saagi'ñ gook jix bhai'x baasɨ'n tas gei'ñ gook jix bhai'x baasɨ'n gu ñi'ook gook jix bhai'x kiicham tɨjɨɨ'ñ; gio ba' dhi' jix duñia' jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas jɨ'dɨlh ka't na ba' mua'kam; gio ba' oo'm gook jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' bɨx jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu Lebitas ka't oo'm jɨ'dɨlh; gio ba' bɨɨx.

Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix jai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim jix jai' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim; gio ba' maa'n jɨ'dɨlh gu Lebitas bhaan gu maa'nkar oidha' maa'nkar.
Ba' jix aa' gu Jawatan Dios gu Moisees bham.
Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam; na pai' dhuuk gu Jordaan gu oidha' gu Kanaan.
Jano' ba' nɨi'ñchudat jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'x pai' mua'kam gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' koi'm.
Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' cham koi mua'kam bɨɨx ka'm ñi'ook na jir bhai' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gui'x jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' vaik jɨ'dɨlh gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam dhi' baasɨ'n gu Jordaan vaik jɨ'dɨlh gu oidha' gu Kanaan; gio ba' ka't jɨ'dɨlh.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jɨ'dɨlh ka't na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ na ba' no'x gu ñi'ook koi'm.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix kavɨk jodai gu ñi'ook vaak jodai mua'kam; gio ba' mua'kam koi.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu jodai gu novɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi gu ñi'ook vaak jodai mua'kam; gio ba' mua'kam koi.
Jano' ba' tu' bɨɨx gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ koi gu ñi'ook vaak jodai mua'kam; gio ba' mua'kam koi.
Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook mua'kam; na pai' dhuuk jix duñia' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam naaka'n bɨɨx gu novɨ jix koi; gio ba' koi; mi' dhɨr mua'kam; na pai' dhuuk jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook mua'kam na pai' dhuuk jix duñia'.
Gu' gu' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix duñia' cham jix duñia' bhaan cham.
Jano' ba' jix duu xoi'kam cham tɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bhaan gu jodai koi vaak jodai cham ka't bhaamki'ñdha' tu' cham bhai'.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu ñi'ook tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' jix koi jurtu'nka' dhi' ñi'ook na tu a'ga.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' mua'kam gu novɨ jir bɨx bhai' jix koi gu ñi'ook gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ñi'ook kiicham ka't; gio ba' bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan ka't Xoi'kam bɨɨx bɨ'ñdhatu' jix bhaan.
Jano' ba' tu' mua'kam gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam mai' gu ñi'ook kiicham.
Jano' ba' jir bɨx bhai' jix koi bakia' mai' gu ñi'ook kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' jix koi mua'kam kooda' cham.
Na gu' kiicham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jix daa bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' mi' dhɨr vaak jodai jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan mua'kam gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu'x ka't gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam jir bɨx bhai' gu ñi'ook bɨx.
Jano' ba' no'x gu ñi'ook oi'ñdha' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook koi mua'kam; gu' ñi'ookdham cham tu' bhaan gu ñi'ook na ba'.
Jano' ba' cham gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim u'uuk gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' mua'kam; na gu' koi'm; gu' koi.
Jano' ba' tu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim u'uuk kiicham na ba' jix duñia' duaka' gu oidha' bɨɨx ka'm jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' pai'; na gu' dhi' gu ɨ'ɨr gu oidha'; mi' dhɨr pai' cham ka't gu ɨ'ɨr ka't gu ñi'ook gu ɨ'ɨr ja'aa.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu oidha' pai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu'; na gu' tu' gu Jawatan Dios tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam chiñia' tattat ja'tkam vaak gu Galaad gu mar gu Makîr gu mar gu Manasees ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Josee; gio ba' tu ñi'ook vupui bhaan gu Moisees chiñia' ɨɨbhidham tattat gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.

Jano' ba' gui'p; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam koi gu oidha' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar; mi' dhɨr gio tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu Jawatan jix maa gu maa'nkar gu Salpaad chulhiiñdha' xibhɨk ma'nkam u'uuvɨ.

Na pai' dhuuk na pai' dhuuk daraibu' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar ka't gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ bɨpna'; gio ba' gu maa'nkar ka't gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ taata'n tattat.
Jano' ba' jano' ba' gu Moisees jix aa'ñdhix gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios bham; gio ba' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Josee tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad bham; gio ba' gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam na ja'p cham gu ñi'ook ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu taat.
Na ba' na ba' gu maa'nkar gu ma'nkam gu Israeel cham ka't bhaan bopxi'ñ; na gu' maa'n gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ tattat.

Jano' ba' no'x mar u'vɨ gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel bɨɨx oi'ñdha' ja'tkam vaak bopxi'ñ gu taat na ba' gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim maa'n gu maa'nkar tattat.
Jano' ba' cham gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu maa'nkar gu ñi'ook bopxi'ñ; gu' bopxi'ñ gu ma'nkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios jix aa'ñdhix gu Moisees jix duu ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad.
Jano' ba' gu Maala gu Tirsa gu ogla gu Milkâ gu Noa ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu Salpaad gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bɨɨx gu ma'nkam.
Jano' ba' ja'tkam vaak gu ma'nkam gu Manasees gu mar gu Josee jix bɨɨx duu gu u'vɨ; gio ba' gu maa'nkar gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam bopxi'ñ ja'tkam vaak gu taat.
Jano' ba' dhi' ja'tkam gu ñi'ook ñi'ook kavɨk jix aa'ñdhix gu Jawatan Dios gu tu' na jix bhai' duukam gu novɨ gu Moisees gu ma'nkam gu Israeel vaak ja'tkam gu Moab ju'ñdharan gu Jordaan gu Jerikoo.
